errors.NOT_A_FEED_ITEM: A ration can only contain feed
errors.DUPLICATE_RATION_ITEM: Each feed can appear only once in a ration
errors.RATION_IN_USE: This ration is assigned to the herd "{{herd}}"
errors.SCENARIO_INCOMPLETE: Enter a ration and a head count

rations.title: Feed rations
rations.description: Daily feed per head by physiological state, and what it costs.
rations.dialogHint: Enter the daily amount per head for each feed.
rations.noFeeds: No feed found. Add it to the items list first
rations.emptyBody: Create rations for pregnant, lactating and other groups.

balance.title: Feed balance
balance.description: How long stock lasts, by actual consumption and by plan.
balance.emptyBody: Add feed to the items list and receive it to see the balance.

plan.title: Daily feeding plan
plan.lambsLeftOut_one: Plus {{count}} suckling lamb: on its mother, not on this ration
plan.lambsLeftOut_other: Plus {{count}} suckling lambs: on their mothers, not on this ration
plan.withoutRationBody: Not counted: {{herds}}. Assign them a ration so the plan is right.

winter.title: Winter plan
winter.description: How much feed the winter takes, what is short, and how much land would grow it.
winter.head: Head count
winter.scenarioPromptTitle: Choose a ration and a head count
winter.scenarioPromptBody: For example, plan the pregnancy ration for 500 ewes.
winter.emptyBody: Assign rations to herds, or use the what-if mode.
winter.unknownTitle: The plan could not be fully checked
winter.unknownBody: These feeds cannot be converted to kilograms: {{names}}. Enter the weight per unit on the item card.
winter.enoughBody: On the current rations there is feed for {{head}} head for {{days}} days.
winter.basisNote: Worked out on each herd's current ration. After lambing, nursing ewes eat more: check that in What-if with the lactation ration.

sowing.title: Land to grow it
sowing.description: The area needed to grow the missing feed yourself.
sowing.together: These feeds come from one crop: the land is set by the feed that needs the most of it, not the sum.
sowing.noCrop: The short feeds are not linked to a crop. Set "Grown from" on the item.

nutrients.title: Nutrient balance
nutrients.perHeadDay: What the ration gives one head a day, against what it needs.
nutrients.clamped: The table has no row for this weight: the {{used}} kg row was read.
nutrients.noHerd: No herd is on this ration, so there is no requirement to compare with. This is what the ration gives.
nutrients.draftEmpty: Choose a feed and enter an amount to see the balance.

reasons.no_weight: No weights are recorded for this herd. Weigh a few animals to get the requirement.
reasons.mixed_species: The herd holds more than one species, so one requirement does not fit it.
reasons.species_not_covered: The requirement table covers sheep only.
reasons.state_not_covered: The requirement table has no rows for this physiological state.

nutrients.missingTitle: Some feeds have no nutrient figures
nutrients.missingHint: Enter them on the item card. Until then the lines that depend on them stay empty.

mix.title: Least-cost mix
mix.description: The cheapest mix of the feeds you choose that covers what one head needs in a day. Prices are what a kilogram costs in stock now.
mix.herdHint: Optional. Its average recorded weight is used
mix.weightRequired: Enter a weight or choose a herd
mix.gainHint: Empty: the usual gain in the table
mix.saveHint: The mix becomes a new ration that you can change afterwards.
mix.infeasibleTitle: No mix of these feeds covers the requirement
mix.shortAlone: {{name}}: within the limits these feeds give at most {{best}} {{unit}}, {{required}} {{unit}} are needed.
mix.shortTogether: {{name}}: {{required}} {{unit}} are needed. That cannot be reached while the other requirements are met.
mix.infeasibleTip: Add a richer feed, raise a maximum, or lower the roughage share.
mix.missingTitle: Some feeds lack figures the mix needs
mix.missingBody: Enter the composition and the feed type on the item card. A price appears once the feed is received into stock.
